reviews.review_text:
Imagine a place where centrality is not just a geographical advantage, but the beating heart of memorable experiences.
The service, impeccable and attentive, becomes part of the experience, anticipating every need and adding that special touch that turns the everyday into extraordinary. But perhaps the highlight is the signature cuisine, a real feast for the senses. 
Dishes made with creativity and passion, which not only satisfy the appetite, but cost stories in every bite.

reviews.review_text: The beautiful place, the super attention! Honorable mention to Carlos. I would define the food as daring Creole food, Andrés, the chef of the house, came to our table to give us all the details of each dish. The seafood cooked to perfection, the ceviche delicious. I would work a little more on the balance of the desserts, the custard apple meringue was not very balanced and it would have been better to feel a colder temperature in the mouth. I would reduce the salt a bit in the cheesecake and give it a crunchy texture. Otherwise incredible 👌🏻
reviews.title: Beautiful place, daring Creole food, very good service

reviews.review_text:
I went to this Restaurant on the recommendation of friends. The experience was totally negative. We located in an area just past the entrance. The waiters attended to us as if they were doing us a favor. About 10' to bring us the letter after requesting it 3 times. The dishes arrived with a 30' difference between the starter and the main dish. The food does not justify what they charge. It seems to me that it is very overrated. I received neither attention nor food to my liking, much less apologies for the delay. The premises were very poorly distributed (ladies' bathroom on the first floor and men's bathroom on the second floor).
Finally, to add the missing touch, they made a mistake on the bill, charging for more glasses of wine than those consumed.
I do not recommend this place, it was a fiasco for me and family.
reviews.title: Terrible service, mediocre food, very overrated

reviews.review_text:
We were eager to try this restaurant because we like to support innovative cuisine and newer chefs. The restaurant looks like an old house and we liked the slightly bohemian decor with yellow walls and bright art in the room we were in.

Service was 5*. Reservation (online) system worked well, the waiter was attentive and explained menu items.

The food..is difficult to rate and had me hesitating as to whether the rating should be lower. Firstly, we asked the waiter to recommend the best dishes and we tried 3 of the dishes. A star for allowing a substitution to beef (done ham style) with veg instead of the fish and it was tasty. A potatoe dish (oscara?) lacked flavour and the duck dish had flavour but was over cooked and dry. The 2 desserts, chocolate mousse type and apple pie were tasty.

Their pisco sour mixed with fruit juice was very good and my friend enjoyed his glass of Malbec.
reviews.title: The right ingredients. But...more flavour

reviews.review_text:
The location, in a part of Miraflores known more for bars than restaurants, is a bit off; however, La Niña is making a name for itself as a sort of small plates, Peruvian Tapas place. 

The space is Uber cool with patios, rooms and levels - all seeming to offer a little different experience. It’s also one of the “go to places” on foodie lists of Lima. 

The general feel is the sort of place you’d expect to find in Coconut Grove in Miami. It’s hip and cool. But, that shouldn’t disuade anyone over 40 from venturing - the staff are crazy friendly and very accommodating. It’s a great place to take a group for good conversation and small plates of shared food.
reviews.title: Hipster

reviews.review_text: I like to try various restaurants and the Peruvian food I have to get up and congratulate chef Andres, what I have tried in my years is best, as an example of his andina tortilla, they have taken the recipe of Spanish tortilla and made it a piece of flavors, the mixture of flavors with Andean ingredients has no comparison, usually I do not like gourmet food but what I have tried that night to have lost the ability, or I thought I had lost the amazing experience.
reviews.title: Food of the gods

reviews.review_text:

Cocktails with good but ungenerous presentation, more ice than liquors. They also brought the dishes we ordered in disorder, so it was not possible to eat at the same time.

reviews.review_text: It is strange how the “fancy” restaurants in Lima are always full. Totally waist of time and money. La Nina is a small trully peruvian Gem. The wines selection is outstanding. The small seasonal menu is perfect. (Ya do not expect 10.000 options of frozen food) bur you can expect a creative and delicious food. Also the attention is amazing. It is my second time here and i can come every day of the week to try all the plates of the menu. Surprise yourself and DO NOT go to the famous ones. You will be treated like garbage there.
reviews.title: Amazing unknown.

reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful afternoon with our group of 9 friends at La Niña.  Beginning with pre dinner drinks on the deck outside and then into the casual dining area for the food.  The chef served a variety of beautifully put together dishes that were shared around the table.  The dishes include fresh seafood, duck, beef, pork - all with a very fresh and local twist. An excellent wine selection was available, the service was great and we left very satisfied!
reviews.title: Outstanding food and great wine selection

reviews.review_text: As for the taste and attention this restaurant is very good, very cozy and with different environments, mainly for couples, the portions are small, the liquors varied, in its price, the expensive dishes

reviews.review_text:
It does not have a very wide card but the flavors of what it offers are good. I focused on the entrances, we were 3 people and with 5 entrances among all it was perfect. They can fill like a bottom plate.

reviews.review_text:
We went to celebrate our friend’s birthday and hoped to expend a good time and good food. We got the first because of our long and sincere friendship but we didn’t got the second. The menu is poor of options. The duck wasn’t well done, the avocado toasts wasn’t tasty. Maybe the best plates were the beef with salad and the octopus . Everything we tried was in such a little size called now: gourmet. For dessert we had a delicious baked pineapple . We didn’t receive a good attention from the waiter. It’s a place that we will never recommend.
Fuimos para pasar un buen rato, lo que sí logramos, pero no obtuvimos una cena de calidad.  La carta es pobre en opciones. Los tamaños de los platos fueron muy pequeños, el pato no estaba bien cocido y las tostadas de palta no tenían nada de espectacular. Tal vez lo mejor fue la entraña con ensalada, el pulpo parrillero y como postre, la piña al horno. No recibimos una buena atención del mozo. Nunca recomendaríamos este restaurante.
reviews.title: Group decision: never come back

reviews.review_text: It has very good location; but the best thing is the personalized attention they provide. They have an innovative proposal, both in drinks and meals (their Min Pao was delicious). It has small facilities that make it cozy, and have used the garden area very well, making it an appropriate place to talk and share. We went yesterday with a group of friends, and we had a great time.
reviews.title: Very recommended

reviews.review_text: I was staying at the Hilton and recommended this restaurant; it is in the center of Miraflores and it is easy to reach. I love restaurants that are copyright and this was no exception. We tried the delicious tasting menu, with pairing and it really was worth it. The sommeliers are very expert and explain every wine to you in detail. The place is nice, full of art and excellent attention. Congratulations.
reviews.title: Wonderful experience

reviews.review_text:
I met the girl in Miraflores today. It's a great place to eat at night and have a drink.
The restaurant is cozy and the decoration is perfect.
We stayed at the bar to talk to Andrés, the chef. We had a great time.
We ate the pancake buns, Dad's omelet and the apple-bitten. For dessert we only ask for the flan. All amazing, though the buns were really extraordinary.
They have a super varied wine letter. We ask for a very good risk and a Malbec.
The attention is the best and the restaurant has a very good atmosphere.
They told us they change the letter regularly, so we'll be back soon
reviews.title: Great!

reviews.review_text: We went on a Monday night a couple of weeks ago.   Restaurant was very quiet - few diners.   Surprising, as they deserve much better.   We went there about 7:30 after going to a movie.  We had been out of the city for a few days and indulged on great food while away, so were looking forward to a light meal.  We decided to share the tasting menu.   Cristian, who provided excellent service throughout, didn't blink an eye as we asked to do that.    By sharing one tasting menu, the amount of food was plenty, given that we were looking forward to a light meal.   And the quality of the food was very good.   Good scores on creativity and presentation of food.   A couple of courses were fine, several were very good, and the desserts were outstanding.    I had Tacama  Dona Ana Chardonnay by the glass, and it was very good - best Peruvian white I have had.   La Nina is not in same league as Central or Maido, but it is a leading contender in the next tier of Lima restaurants.   It is centrally located near Park Kennedy/Ovalo de Miraflores, but on a fairly quiet street.   Perhaps this is why it was not so busy.  With  quality of food, service and atmosphere, it deserves to be much busier.    Kudos to the La Nina team, and we wish you much success.
reviews.title: Definitely worth a visit

reviews.review_text: We did a gastronomic tour of Peru and ate at all the top-rated restaurants in Lima such as Astrid y Gaston and Central. We loved so much the food in La Niña that we actually went for a second time on the night before going back home. The flavors and the textures of the plates we tried were amazing. The chef, Andrés Orellana, personally explained every dish we tried and, being also a sommelier, he paired them with an amazing cup of wine. We are already looking at plane tickets to go back! :)
reviews.title: Best tasting menu in Lima

reviews.review_text:
